system.description:
You see a melee attack coming and your body doesn’t allow it to proceed any further. You instinctively use your hand or feet to not only attempt to parry the attack, but to also drive the attack into the ground, getting it stuck and opening the triggering creature up to a counter attack.

When you or an allied creature is hit with a melee attack, the affected creature gain a +2 bonus to their AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses as a result, you can make a weapon attack against the hostile creature, dealing your [Weapons damage] on a hit.

Chain 1: If you score a hit with your weapon attack, reduce the targets AC by 2, until the end of their next turn.

Chain 2: You may make two attacks, against the triggering creature, regardless if they miss or not.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the counter attack damage by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the AC bonus by +2.
